en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a group of well‑dressed men and women gathered around an ornate indoor fountain or mineral spring. The people wear early 20th‑century European clothing, including bowler hats, long coats, and wide‑brimmed women's hats. The fountain basin is elaborately carved, and the surrounding structure has large glass windows and decorative columns, suggesting a spa pavilion or pump room. There is red handwriting across the right side and lower center of the image, and a crossed‑out printed number near the top.
